claim: On every Nightmare level pests and bosses start at 40% health and reach full health by 8:00, so the first minutes are the cheapest time to get stronger.
evidence: Stated in the game facts given at loop start; no game played yet.

claim: Steam-vent survived seed 202 NM1 under lockstep, so the earlier seed dependence was reaction lag.
evidence: L1.I1.G3 steam-vent alive at 300s on NM1 seed 101, but L1.I2.G4 steam-vent died at 166s on NM1 seed 202 to boss amusing (96.5 damage); the lead is seed-dependent.

claim: Raising extraDamage from 0.02 to 0.06 does not help; fry-knives died sooner.
evidence: L1.I1.G5 died 130s at level 4 versus G1 baseline died 154s at level 8; one game each.

claim: The Festival Mascot boss (amusing) arrives around 2:00 on Nightmare 1 and deals a large share of early damage (37-47 in a 300s game).
evidence: L1.I1.G3 steam-vent boss:amusing 36.6 damage; L1.I1.G5 fry-knives boss:amusing 46.6 damage, died at 130s. Seed 101 only.

claim: extraDamage 0.06 did not help; both fry-knives games died early, but weapon choice dominated.
evidence: L1.I1.G5 died 130s vs G1 154s; one game each, both fry-knives, so weapon is the confound.

claim: On Nightmare 10 every tested start (steam-vent, sprout-satellites, rosti-disc, steam-vent 8 with root-network) died within 127s at level 8 or lower; pests such as bowling-ball, sand-crab and aphid do most of the damage.
evidence: L1.I2.G1 died 86s, G2 127s, G3 118s, G5 92s, all seed 303; one game each.

claim: Lockstep 1 (no reaction lag while models decide) improves early survival on Nightmare 10 with steam-vent.
evidence: L1.I3.G2 lockstep alive 150s vs live G1 died 123s (seed 303); L1.I4.G3 and G5 alive at 300s, G1 died 244s, G4 died 213s; live control L1.I4.G2 died 124s (seed 404); sonnet-high L1.I3 fresh seed 101 lockstep G4 and G5 alive at 240s vs live I2 games dead at 132-142s. On Nightmare 1 lockstep steam-vent was alive at 300s on seeds 303 (L1.I4.G1) and 606 (L1.I6.G4, G5). Still untested past 5:00 from a fresh natural build.

claim: On Nightmare 10 the Festival Mascot (amusing) at 2:00 is the main killer of early live (lockstep 0) runs: it dealt 74 to 99 damage and landed the killing blow in the three seed-101 steam-vent games that reached it. Under lockstep 1 it still dealt 123.5 damage in one game but Tibo survived.
evidence: L1.I2.G2 boss:amusing 99.5 damage, died 142s; L1.I2.G4 79, died 132s; L1.I2.G5 74.1, died 132s (all live). L1.I3.G4 lockstep: amusing 123.5 damage, health 43/149 at 2:00, alive and 163/163 at 3:00.

claim: Opening chests and evolving early (first chest by about 1:35) separates 300s survivors from deaths on NM10; the three bosses at 2:00, 3:00 and 4:00 kill weak builds.
evidence: L1.I4.G3 and G5 had 7 to 9 boss chests and 9 bosses killed, alive at 300s; G1 had 0 boss chests and died at 244s to The Masher; G4 had 1 and died at 213s.

claim: distrustBossRange and bossOfferRange (250 to 300) do not reliably lower total damage and can raise it, so the full run leaves them at 0.
evidence: Earlier pairs show no consistent direction in 8 pairs (seed 505 NM10 67 vs 30; fresh NM1 seed 606 185 vs 36; 10:00 gyms lower with ranges, 45 vs 98 and 58 vs 79). L1.I9.G5, nm1-min5-fresh with chest-first plus ranges 250, died at 74s (Late Blight 103 damage, 6 dashes, 2 picks), while chest-first without ranges survived 3 of 3 on the same gym.

claim: A mid-strength build (about level 10 with steam-vent evolving to pressure-cooker) clears the 2:00 and 3:00 bosses on Nightmare 10 under any movement setting, so build strength matters more than movement settings for boss survival.
evidence: L1.I3.G1/G2/G3 from gym boss-nm10-strong: all alive after 90s with 16, 8 and 36 damage taken (lockstep, lockstep plus ranges, live).

claim: The next full run is Nightmare 1 and has to survive 20:00, but training games cap at 300s, so minutes 5-20 can only be tested from gyms saved at later times.
evidence: Ladder state: no level won yet, so the next full run is Nightmare 1. Game length cap is 300s per training game.

claim: A longer planEvery (10 instead of 5) may hurt survival on Nightmare 10 under lockstep.
evidence: L1.I5.G5 planEvery 10 died at 188.7s with 194 damage (boss:amusing 88.9, tomato-leech 71.2), no boss chests, level 11; seed 505 playbook games G3 and G4 survived 300s. One game.

claim: On Nightmare 1, builds saved at 6:00 and 10:00 (level 20 to 38, evolved) survive 300s more at near-full health, so the early minutes are where runs are lost.
evidence: L1.I6.G1/G2/G3 and L1.I4.G2/G4/G5: all alive at full health, 11 to 98 damage taken.

claim: A strong steam-vent build (level 20+ with hot-streak or pressure-cooker and HP passives) survives 5 minutes from 6:00 or 10:00 on Nightmare 1 with at most 100 damage under the default playbook, so those gyms cannot separate knobs or prompts.
evidence: L1.I4.G2 12, G3 14, G4 98, G5 45 damage; L1.I6.G1 79, G2 58, G3 11 damage; all seven alive at 300s with 192+ max HP.

claim: Lockstep 1 steam-vent survives the seed 202 NM1 opening that killed it under live play; planEvery 3 and a peeler start also survive.
evidence: L1.I7.G1 alive 300s 56 damage, G2 planEvery 3 69 damage, G3 peeler 93 damage, all seed 202; live L1.I2.G4 died 166s.

claim: A natural Nightmare 1 build at 5:00 (level 17, no evolution) is at risk from the 6:00 to 8:00 bosses (Late Blight, Sir Strawman, Fryer King) under the default playbook, unlike the strong swapped-in gyms.
evidence: L1.I5.G1 baseline died at 198s (Fryer King 77.5, Late Blight 68.9; 2 boss chests, no evolution). L1.I6.G1 baseline died at 147s (Late Blight 67.9, Sir Strawman 58.1; 1 boss chest, no evolution). L1.I7.G4 sonnet-medium baseline from the 5:00 state survived with 55 damage. Two deaths in three default games on nm1-min5-fresh.

claim: A goal prompt that puts chests and elites first while health is above half gives many more boss chests and evolutions than the default prompt, and it carried the full run through the first 16 minutes of Nightmare 1.
evidence: Chest-first survived 12 of 12 natural builds in training. L1.I10 full run: lived 18:36 with 32 boss chests and 5 evolutions, hp 192/192 until 17:00. The default prompt died 3 of 4 on nm1-min5-fresh.

claim: An evolve-focused planner.pick prompt does not help on Nightmare 1 and may hurt.
evidence: L1.I8.G2 died at 88s from nm1-min5-fresh with no evolution. L1.I8.G4 seed 707: 333 kills and 0 chests against baseline G3 1575 kills. L1.I5.G2 survived at 50/120 and L1.I5.G5 survived with 981 kills against 1097.

claim: Steam-vent, lockstep 1 and the chest-first goal prompt lived 17:20 on Nightmare 1 in the full run, the best result so far.
evidence: L1.I10 sonnet-medium full run seed SEOJT4: 17:20, level 62, 25 boss chests, 4 evolutions. sonnet-high full run seed 1HY6I94 later lived 18:36 with the same base.

claim: Raising eliteSeconds from 20 to 35 does not give more boss chests or less damage on a natural Nightmare 1 build.
evidence: L1.I8.G5 from nm1-min5-fresh: 12 boss chests and 266 damage, dropped 7 elite goals and spent 7 on evade (health 43/120 at 6:00, 8 dashes at 6:30-7:30). Earlier chest-first games on that gym with eliteSeconds 20 had 12 to 26 chests and 29 to 374 damage. One game.

claim: A steam-vent start beats a peeler start on a fresh Nightmare 1 map under the chest-first playbook.
evidence: Seed 909: steam-vent 60 damage, 19 boss chests, 3 evolutions (fry-fortress 1:51, pressure-cooker 2:11, golden-harvest 4:04); peeler 218 damage, 14 boss chests, 2 evolutions (factory-reset 3:07, mandoline-fury 4:00). Seed 202 peeler also survived with 93 damage. One game each on seed 909.

claim: A gym saved on an older game build cannot be loaded after the page build changes, so gyms should be used soon after they are saved.
evidence: L1.I8.G4: checkpoint gym-nm1-min5-s808-chest was saved on build sim-wTU8O3Z8.js and the page runs sim-DA4RGMxM.js, so the game did not play.

claim: The chest-first goal prompt keeps pursuing chests and Beetle Nests with a boss within 200-300 units and hundreds of pests while health is above half, which caused both the 17:20 and 18:36 deaths; it needs a boss/crowd exception.
evidence: sonnet-medium L1.I10: 17:03-17:20 chest goals failed twice with the Titan near, hp 120 to 7. sonnet-high L1.I10: 17:00-18:28 chests C66283, C66485, C66396 and nest P348 failed or were dropped with the Titan and Kraken 130-290 away; hp 192 to 74, evade only at 18:28 (74/192), dead 18:36.

claim: An HP/dash pick prompt did not help on the full-build gym either: it died at 18:09, earlier than the baseline at 18:32.
evidence: L2.I4.G3 died 18:09 (Titan 208, ice-imp 181, Kraken 169) vs G1 baseline 18:32; one game each.

claim: Gyms built by playing a natural build to 15:00 or 16:40 usually fail because the build dies on the way; late gyms need a swapped-in loadout, and even swapped loadouts with evolved late weapons crashed the bot twice (exit code 1), so copy a loadout shape that has saved before.
evidence: L2.I1: nm1-min15-late died at 8:32 and nm1-min16-titan at 6:37; L2.I2: -b gyms with the full run's evolved loadout exited with code 1; earlier loadout gyms (nm1-min10-mine, nm1-min6-mine) saved. L2.I3 retries with the nm1-min10-mine loadout shape.

claim: Leaving gold, shrines, skips and rerolls unused wastes power: the full run earned 7946 gold and spent 838, used 0 shrines, and bought 0 items.
evidence: L1.I10 full run: gold earned 7946, spent 838, crates bought 6, items bought 0, shrines used 0; 13 skips and 22 rerolls available at the end; took Baked Potato at 18:03. Whether spending helps is untested.

claim: On Nightmare 1 the pest count doubles from about 400 to about 790 at 16:00, and ice-imp, grease-fiend and the 17:00 and 18:00 bosses (Compost Titan, Ketchup Kraken) deal most late damage, in bursts of 70-100 hp.
evidence: L1.I10 stats: enemies 403 at 15:00, 788 at 16:00, 800 at 17:00; damage by source ice-imp 334, kraken 321, titan 243, grease-fiend 139; bursts 79 hp at 14:00, 252 at 17:00, 551 at 18:00.

claim: Steam-vent with lockstep 1 and the chest-first goal prompt is a reliable base: two full runs lived 17:20 and 18:36 on Nightmare 1. The unsolved part is minutes 16-20.
evidence: sonnet-medium L1.I10 17:20 (level 62); sonnet-high L1.I10 18:36 (level 54, 40196 kills); both near full hp until 16:00-17:00.

claim: The swapped grease-fire loadout gyms (nm1-min15-c, nm1-min16-titan-c) are too strong to test late fixes: they pass 20:00 with little damage, so the Titan and Kraken barely hurt them.
evidence: L2.I3: G5 from 15:00 reached 20:00 with 11 damage; four games from 16:40 all passed 20:00 (deaths at 20:17 to 21:10 came from Harvester and Fryer King); Titan and Kraken dealt 0 to 70.

claim: On the full-build gym the boss-aware goal passes 20:00 in 4 of 5 games where the baseline and pick variants die at 18:07-18:32; on lo-full and lo-surv the evidence is mixed, so it is not yet proven across builds.
evidence: L2.I4/L2.I5 full gym: boss-aware text passed 20:00 in 4 of 5 (died 21:06, 21:03, 20:33, 20:16; planEvery 3 variant 18:52). L2.I6 lo-full boss-aware passed 20:00 in 2 of 2 (died 21:02, 20:11), against an earlier single lo-full game at 18:29. A rewritten text with a 350-unit rule died 18:37 on the full gym, so the exact wording matters. Baselines on the full gym died 18:07-18:32.

claim: From the lo-full gym at 16:40, the chest-first baseline gets past 20:00 (both games), so a damage-passive build with pressure-cooker, gratin-arc, mash-avalanche, tater-minigun and mandoline-fury can survive the Titan, Kraken and Harvester; lo-surv is the failing gym.
evidence: L2.I1.G1 died 20:45 (Harvester 332, Kraken 305, Titan 296 damage taken, healed back); L2.I1.G5 died 21:11 (Fryer King 312); both passed 20:00 at 211 max hp. lo-surv: L2.I1.G3 died 18:07.

claim: A permissive late-game dash prompt makes things worse: it spends many charges and dies sooner than the default prompt.
evidence: L2.I2 lo-surv: permissive dash A died 17:55 (30 dashes, 1215 damage), B died 17:20 (18 dashes, 950 damage); default baselines died 18:07 and 19:13 with 4 dashes at most. distrustSeconds 10 with 0 dashes died 18:21. More dashing did not lower damage.

claim: distrustSeconds 10 does not help at 16:40-20:00 on Nightmare 1.
evidence: L2.I2.G4 lo-surv died 18:21 (852 damage: ice-imp 338, Kraken 214, Titan 208), inside the baseline range of 18:07 to 19:13. One game.

claim: A gold/shop sentence in the chest-first goal prompt is unresolved: it died at 17:26 on lo-surv, but survived to 20:40 on the full gym with items A and 8000 gold. Late in the run it rarely produces purchases.
evidence: L2.I2.G5 lo-surv died 17:26 with 688 gold earned, 0 spent. L2.I4.G5 full gym, 8000 gold, items A, gold sentence: alive 20:40, 616 damage, 1 crate bought. L2.I5.G3 and G4 (boss-aware plus gold rule, 8000 gold, only Potato Knish) died 18:47 and 18:19 with 0 bought and spot goals 0 done, so spending is not working in the crowd, and no spend has lowered damage yet.

claim: The lo-surv gym kills the hp/dash build (Butter Socks, Stuffed Skin) between 17:53 and 19:13, but the same map with damage passives (Butter Pat, Aged Russet) passed 20:00 twice, so the cause is the build and not the map.
evidence: L2.I3.G3 and G4 (damage passives, lo-surv map): both died 20:07 to the Harvester after passing 20:00 (741 and 817 damage). Hp/dash baselines died 18:07, 19:13 and 17:53 (1114, 1609, 1069 damage). Lo-full (damage passives, other seed) passed 20:00 twice.

claim: Damage passives (Butter Pat 5, Aged Russet 5) beat hp/dash passives (Butter Socks 5, Stuffed Skin 5) for the 16:40-20:00 stretch on Nightmare 1, so late picks should not trade a damage passive for hp or dash.
evidence: Damage build 4 of 4 past 20:00 (lo-full 20:45 and 21:11; lo-surv swap 20:07 and 20:07). Hp/dash build 0 of 3 (18:07, 19:13, 17:53). The full gym hp/dash pick prompt died 18:09 (L2.I4.G3). One caveat: the full gym with damage passives and few items died at 18:32.

claim: Starch Plating 5 in place of Stuffed Skin is not a fix: it lasted about as long as the hp/dash baselines' upper range and shorter than damage passives.
evidence: L2.I3.G1 died 19:40 (1383 damage, grease-fiend 528); G2 died 20:18 (1802 damage, ice-imp 403, Titan 383, mud-golem 329). Damage-passive swaps died 20:07 twice with 741 and 817 damage. Two games.

claim: Items decide the full gym (seed 1JV4MGC, damage build, 16:40): with nine defensive items (2 Baked Buckler, 2 Ghost Skin, Thorny Jacket, 2 Spud Muffin, 2 Vampire Tot) it passed 20:00 in 2 of 2 games at 259 max hp, while the same build with the damage items A or the Potato Knish alone died at 18:06-18:32. Which items matter (armor, dodge, max hp, thorns, kill-heal) is untested.
evidence: L2.I4 items B: G3 alive 20:40 (288 damage), G4 alive 20:40 (569 damage, 259 hp). Items A: G1 died 18:14 (Kraken 321), G2 died 18:06 (Titan 347). Knish-only baselines died 18:32 and 18:07. One caveat: items A plus 8000 gold and the gold sentence (G5) survived to 20:40 with 616 damage and 221 hp.

claim: planEvery 3 on top of the boss-aware goal does not help late: it died at 18:52 on the full gym, earlier than the other boss-aware games.
evidence: L2.I5.G4 died 18:52 (Kraken 641, ice-imp 124) vs 20:16-21:06 for the other boss-aware games; one game.

claim: Late in the run spot goals (crates, Fry Cart, shrines) mostly fail or get dropped in the 800-pest crowd, so unspent gold stays unspent unless the goal rule fires while no boss is near.
evidence: L2.I4.G5: 8000 gold, spot goals 1 done / 6 gave up / 11 dropped, 1 crate bought. L2.I4.G4: spot 3 done / 2 gave up / 8 dropped, 3 crates bought. Full run: 7946 gold earned, 838 spent, 0 items bought.

claim: evadeSeconds 15 does not reliably beat 8 on the full gym; the single 20:40 survivor was not repeated.
evidence: L2.I7: full gym evade 15 died 19:34 and 18:16, lo-full evade 15 died 20:07; playbook repeats died 18:04 and 18:41. L2.I6 (my boss-aware text): evade 15 on the full gym died 18:07, alive 20:40 (G2, health 42/221 at 19:00, Kraken 1392 damage, 10 dashes), died 18:15; evade 25 died 18:16; lo-full evade 15 alive 20:40. Evade 15 passes 20:00 in 2 of 6 on the full gym, so it is not reliable.

claim: The current playbook goal text (boss rule at 300 units) does not carry the full gym past 18:41; the boss-aware text that passed 20:00 4 of 5 earlier is not the one in the playbook, so wording matters a lot.
evidence: L2.I7.G1 died 18:04 (Kraken 151, ice-imp 125), G2 died 18:41 (Kraken 428, ice-imp 162); baselines before died 18:07-18:32.

claim: No goal-text, boss-range, evade-length or hurt-prompt variant tried in L2.I8 beats the playbook baseline on the full gym; the 18:00 Kraken, Titan and ice-imp window is not fixed by prompts or knobs.
evidence: L2.I8 on nm1-min16-full: strict evade text died 18:15, plus ranges 300 18:42, plus evade 15 19:59, plus boss-aware hurt prompt 18:23, playbook text plus ranges 300 18:31. Baselines died 18:04-18:41 (L2.I5, L2.I7).

claim: On the full gym every prompt and knob variant tried so far (boss-aware text, evade 8/15/25, boss ranges, planEvery 3, hp/dash picks, gold sentence) dies at 18:04-18:52 in most games. The only variant that passed 20:00 in 2 of 2 was holding nine defensive items, so the next test is which items carry it.
evidence: L2.I4 items B: G3 and G4 alive 20:40. Items A and prompt/knob variants in L2.I4-L2.I8: 18:04-18:52 in most games, with 20:00 passes in only 3 of 15 or so (L2.I5.G5, L2.I6.G2, medium's boss-aware runs). L2.I7 of this iteration splits set B into armor/dodge and max hp/sustain halves.

claim: Armor and dodge items were the only late lever that held in gyms, but the last full run died at 6:42 before items mattered; early survival still needs work.
evidence: L2.I9 gyms alive 20:40; L2.I10 full run died 6:42 with no items.

claim: A chest-first goal prompt with a 'many enemies close' evade exception makes the bot evade almost all game, starving chests and evolutions, and died at 6:42.
evidence: L2.I10 full run: evade goal 43 done, 1 chest opened, 0 elites, no evolution, max hp 120, died 6:42 to Late Blight. Earlier plain chest-first full runs lived 17:20 and 18:36.

claim: Scattering level-ups across Steam Vent, Hash Hawk and Locked Gatling with no catalyst plus rerolls leaves no evolution by 6:00; the build must commit to one weapon plus catalyst.
evidence: L2.I10 full run: Steam Vent 3/8, Hash Hawk 1/8, Locked Gatling 7/8, Masher Grip 4/5, no Root Network, two Reroll picks, no evolution at 6:42.
